title: Direct elimination puts the inverse infinity norm strictly between 18/5 and 361/100 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, rational elimination of the normalized Schur section on `0,1,2,7,8,9` puts the inverse infinity norm strictly between `18/5` and `361/100`.
- The certificate snaps the normalized matrix outward onto multiples of `10^{-12}`, eliminates the midpoint, and bounds the interval residual by `10^{-11}`.
- The norm is strictly below the Neumann ceiling `27`. No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized section, not an all-size inverse bound.
